purpose: Fresh post-v3 synthetic challenge set intended to estimate robustness to wording variation. Cases should be treated as evaluation-only for this iteration.
limitations: Synthetic and manually authored by the project author; not production sampled or independently annotated.
External LLM calls are disabled; only the offline rules-first path is measured.
Results are exploratory and do not establish real-world generalisation or clinical safety.

cases.message: Could we rearrange the nurse visit for Tuesday?
Please push the appointment out by four days.
We need a different slot because Friday is inconvenient.
Can we do the home visit later in the day?
Please set it for seven days from now.
We have to call off the nurse visit.
Please withdraw this booking; the service is no longer required.
You don't need to send anyone for this visit.
Yes, we'll be available at the original time.
I'm not trying to cancel; I only have a question about the visit.
Can you check if the nurse has left the clinic yet?
I may need to change things, but I don't know yet.
Cancel this visit and move the next one to Thursday.
